name: Fist Fighting Practice Arena
request:
I want a simple fighting game with fist fighting animations from the Marketplace, a practice dummy to test on, VFX and SFX when attacking, and a hit counter that goes up every time I hit the dummy.

Confirmed test decisions: Use a bright, stylized practice arena with cartoonish impact VFX and SFX. Use R15 characters and the punching animation clip in the selected Marketplace R15 Punching Animations pack by Auevi (model 12061946559). The practice dummy is stationary, indestructible, does not fight back and has no health or defeat condition. The hit counter increases once per confirmed punch on the dummy, stays unchanged on misses, persists across respawns, and resets only for a new play session. No reset button is needed. Choose sensible defaults for remaining cosmetic details. Keep Marketplace selections subject to asset inspection and native playback verification.

nodes.purpose: Server-authoritative validation of attack cooldown, attacker health/state, and distance/facing to the dummy's hit reference point; decides hit or miss.

nodes.name: Practice Dummy Target

nodes.name: Hit Effects Controller
nodes.purpose: On a confirmed hit, spawns the cartoon impact VFX and plays the punch impact SFX at the contact position on clients.

nodes.name: Hit Counter Service
nodes.purpose: Tracks confirmed hits per player in server memory keyed by UserId, persists across that player's respawns, resets only on server/session restart.

nodes.name: Hit Counter HUD
nodes.purpose: Persistent ScreenGui showing the player's current hit count; rebinds on CharacterAdded and updates live from server counter events.

spec.title: Fist Fighting Practice Arena
spec.summary: Bright, stylized single-arena experience for an R15 character to practice punches on a stationary training dummy. On spawn the player is on a sunlit, cartoon-colored arena floor with a raised, spotlit pedestal a few studs ahead holding the practice dummy (Training Dummy asset 1245720733). The player walks up, presses the attack input, and the server-validated punch plays the Auevi R15 Punching Animations clip (asset 12061946559, clip key 1/1/18/1) on the attacker for all clients to see. When the swing lands on the dummy's hit reference point within range, the server confirms the hit, the cartoon 'Hit vfx m1 boxing' effect (86089736228455) spawns at the contact point, the 'Punch Impact 1' sound (132504023010884) plays there, and a HUD hit counter increments by exactly one. Misses play the animation with no VFX/SFX/counter change. The dummy is anchored, has no health, never retaliates, and cannot be defeated. The hit counter is server-held per player (keyed by UserId), survives respawns, and only resets when the server session restarts — no reset button is provided. This is a small, focused combat-feedback loop, not a multi-enemy fighting game.
spec.visualDirection: Cartoon arena palette: warm sandy-yellow floor mat with bold white boundary stripes, sky-blue accent walls or low barriers, and saturated primary-color trim (red/blue) on the dummy's pedestal to draw the eye immediately from spawn. Spawn faces the pedestal directly; a single warm spotlight (SpotLight/PointLight) highlights the dummy so it reads as the obvious interaction target. The dummy stands on a rounded, chunky pedestal with slightly oversized proportions to match a stylized, non-realistic tone. Impact feedback is exaggerated and readable: the cartoon VFX pack's burst/star shapes at the fist-contact point, paired with the punch SFX, both firing only on confirmed hits. HUD: a single rounded top-corner counter panel with a bold numeral and a small fist/glove icon, high-contrast against the sky backdrop, always visible and unobtrusive elsewhere. No clutter beyond the arena, pedestal, dummy, and HUD — keep the scene legible and small in scope.

plan.title: Fist Fighting Practice Arena
plan.summary: Bright, stylized single-arena experience for an R15 character to practice punches on a stationary training dummy. arena.title: Fist Fighting Practice Arena
arena.summary: Bright, stylized single-arena experience for an R15 character to practice punches on a stationary training dummy. On spawn the player is on a sunlit, cartoon-colored arena floor with a raised, spotlit pedestal a few studs ahead holding the practice dummy (Training Dummy asset 1245720733). The player walks up, presses the attack input, and the server-validated punch plays the Auevi R15 Punching Animations clip (asset 12061946559, clip key 1/1/18/1) on the attacker for all clients to see. When the swing lands on the dummy's hit reference point within range, the server confirms the hit, the cartoon 'Hit vfx m1 boxing' effect (86089736228455) spawns at the contact point, the 'Punch Impact 1' sound (132504023010884) plays there, and a HUD hit counter increments by exactly one. Misses play the animation with no VFX/SFX/counter change. The dummy is anchored, has no health, never retaliates, and cannot be defeated. The hit counter is server-held per player (keyed by UserId), survives respawns, and only resets when the server session restarts — no reset button is provided. This is a small, focused combat-feedback loop, not a multi-enemy fighting game.
arena.visualDirection: Cartoon arena palette: warm sandy-yellow floor mat with bold white boundary stripes, sky-blue accent walls or low barriers, and saturated primary-color trim (red/blue) on the dummy's pedestal to draw the eye immediately from spawn. Spawn faces the pedestal directly; a single warm spotlight (SpotLight/PointLight) highlights the dummy so it reads as the obvious interaction target. The dummy stands on a rounded, chunky pedestal with slightly oversized proportions to match a stylized, non-realistic tone. Impact feedback is exaggerated and readable: the cartoon VFX pack's burst/star shapes at the fist-contact point, paired with the punch SFX, both firing only on confirmed hits. HUD: a single rounded top-corner counter panel with a bold numeral and a small fist/glove icon, high-contrast against the sky backdrop, always visible and unobtrusive elsewhere. No clutter beyond the arena, pedestal, dummy, and HUD — keep the scene legible and small in scope.
